First release. An MCP server and Claude Code plugin that lets an AI agent play,
test and build Game Boy, Game Boy Color and Game Boy Advance games, using the
bundled EmulatorJS cores (mgba, gambatte) in headless Chromium. Nothing else to
install.

## Install

- Claude Code: `/plugin install gb-gbc-gba-test --marketplace sandrinsol/gb-gbc-gba-test-mcp`
- Other MCP hosts: clone, `cd harness && npm install`, and point the host at
  `harness/mcp-server.mjs` (see [harness/README.md](https://github.com/sandrinsol/gb-gbc-gba-test-mcp/blob/v1.4.0/harness/README.md)).

## What it does

- **Play and inspect:** input, waits that stop on a RAM or screen condition, screenshots,
  RAM/CPU/sprite/VRAM reads, RAM writes, save states, cheats, battery saves.
  Runs are deterministic: the same steps give the same frames and RAM every time.
- **Test:** step scripts, golden images with diffs, RAM assertions, A/B comparison
  of two ROMs, RAM search, scripts exported from a session, a CLI runner for CI.
- **Record:** GIF, animated PNG, WebM and MP4 (with sound when a full ffmpeg is
  installed); clips saved automatically when a check fails.
- **Develop (new in this version):**
  - `build` with compiler errors as `file:line`, then loads the new ROM
  - symbol names (`.sym`, `.noi`, `.elf`, `.map`) accepted wherever an address is
  - `describe`: the screen as text
  - `watch` variables
  - `check`: hardware rules (ROM header, crashes, stack, sprite limits, lag frames)
  - `background`: converts art and Tiled maps
  - `sprite`: sprite art pipeline
  - `new_project` starter games for RGBDS, GBDK-2020 and GBA C, each with a test,
    CI workflow and dev container
- **Plugin:** skills for testing, homebrew development, a hardware reference,
  playtesting and CI, plus a `gb-tester` agent.

## Limits

- No debugger (breakpoints, single-stepping).
- VRAM writes made while the screen is drawing can't be detected.
- Audio stays in step with the frames but isn't bit-exact between runs.
